Companies that prioritize diversity and inclusion achieve better business outcomes because diverse teams bring wider perspectives to problem-solving, reducing groupthink and improving decision quality. This expanded range of viewpoints allows organizations to identify innovative solutions and avoid the pitfalls of uniform thinking that often lead to flawed strategies. 

Inclusive workplaces demonstrate higher employee engagement and retention, reducing costly turnover. Employees who feel valued and included are more likely to remain committed to their roles, which preserves institutional knowledge and lowers the financial burdens associated with recruiting and training new staff. 

Workforce diversity improves an organization's ability to understand and serve a diverse customer base. Teams that mirror the demographics of their markets can anticipate varying needs and preferences more accurately, resulting in products and services that drive greater customer satisfaction and revenue growth.
--- END ---
Output the JSON object described above, and nothing else.
